jobs.title: Data Science/AI Intern | 2027 Summer Internship Program at Verisk
jobs.description: Employer: Verisk Expires: 11/23/2026 Program Overview:Verisk's 2027 Summer Internship Program is designed to provide you with meaningful real-world experience, professional development, and networking opportunities. Recognized as a Top 100 Internship Program by Yello and WayUp, our program empowers interns to make a tangible impact while learning from industry experts and building connections across the organization.This is a full-time (40 hours/week), paid internship program spanning ten weeks from June through August 2027. Participation in the program requires that you are located near your assigned office, as our hybrid work schedule requires interns to work in the office at least 3 days per week throughout the summer.Should you be invited back after your AI internship, you will have the opportunity to join a premier full-time program, the AI Excellence Program. This program combines real business impact from day one with a 12-month structured journey to accelerate AI capabilities. This is not a traditional entry-level program—it’s a launchpad for careers in AI-powered innovation, where you will collaborate across functions, influence real decisions, and accelerate your growth in a global organization.As an AI Intern, you will work at the intersection of business, technology, and data, applying AI to solve enterprise-wide challenges and drive measurable impact.We are hiring in the following U.S. locations:Lehi, UTOpen positions:1 AI Intern1 Data Science InternApplication deadline: Sunday, Nov 22 @ 11:59pm ETRecruitment Process:We want to get to know YOU. Once you apply, our team will review your application. Successful candidates will be invited to a two-stage interview process including:AI Project Portfolio and Cover Letter: Should your resume get selected, you will be asked to submit your answer to a given prompt as well as a ZIP file containing examples of projects, coursework, research, or other work where you leveraged artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or related technologies.Digital Interview/Technical Assessment: Our team is keen to get to know you. We will ask you a series of questions in order to learn about what drives you and your career interests and aspirations – this is your opportunity to make yourself stand out from the pack. If you're being considered for a more technical role, we will send you a 1 hour coding challenge to test your skills!Recruiter Screening Call: During this round, you’ll connect with a member of our campus recruiting team for a brief conversation. We’ll review your background, discuss your interests and goals, and share more about the Summer Internship Program. This is also a great opportunity for you to ask questions and learn more about what it’s like to start your career at Verisk.Final Live Virtual Interview: This round is to determine if Verisk’s culture is right for you. You'll have the opportunity to speak with several members of our actuarial recruitment committee.Offer: Our committee will meet and discuss your candidacy. Should you be extended an offer, we will advise you of the business and location where your internship will take place.What You Could Learn:Use AI and data-driven insights to solve real business challenges that impact customers, operations, and strategy across the enterprise.Develop cutting-edge AI skills while learning how leading organizations use technology to solve complex business problems.Collaborate with teams across technology, product, analytics, HR, and finance in AI Labs where you work to automate processes and solve business problemsYou'll have opportunities to experiment with emerging AI technologies, build future-ready skills, and learn from experts across the organization.Help shape how AI transforms the future of work while solving challenges that improve how employees and customers experience our businessComplete learning and development sessions, attend networking events, and showcase successes with leadership at key events.What we’re looking forEnrolled in a bachelors or masters program.Must be graduating in December 2027 or May/June 2028.Must be available to begin the internship program on June 2, 2027, and participate in the full 10-week program.Hands-on experience using AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude in everyday work, projects, or learningExperience using AI beyond basic prompting (e.g., workflows, automations, or applied use cases)Exposure to tools like Excel, Power BI, Tableau or similarPrior experience utilizing data, technology, or AI to solve a problemAbility to use AI to support problem-solving, decision-making, and process improvementComfort working with data. This includes analyzing information, spotting trends, and building simple dashboards or reportsExcellent communication and time management skillsAbility to collaborate across teams and adapt in a fast-paced environmentProactive, self-driven mindset with a willingness to experiment and continuously learn The Intern Program is not eligible for work visa sponsorship. If you will require work visa sponsorship (e.g. H1-B following CPT/OPT) after completing your degree, you do not meet the basic requirements of the summer intern role.

jobs.title: Student Trainee (Energy Industry Analysis) at Federal Energy Regulatory Commission
jobs.description: Employer: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Expires: 11/23/2026 The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) is ranked within the top 5 mid-size agencies as a "Best Place to Work" in the Federal government! Our Pathways Internship Program provides students the opportunity to acquire first-hand experience in the energy industry, while gaining exposure to the Commission's work. This Student Trainee (Energy Industry Analysis) vacancy will be used to fill multiple intern positions in OAL, OEMR and OERA. his vacancy is for a Spring/Summer 2027 internship.While the duties of the Student Trainee (Energy Industry Analysis) may vary depending on office placement, some of your typical work assignments may include:In the Office of Administrative Litigation (OAL), Student Trainee (EIAs) assist analysts with the review, summary, and analysis of data to use in the settlement and litigation of cases before Administrative Law Judges at the Commission. This assistance may include preparing spreadsheets to summarize cost, volume, or economic data, managing discovery responses, researching precedent, reading testimony, and attending settlement conferences and hearings.In The Office of Energy Market Regulation (OEMR): Assisting professional staff members in performing analyses of economic and regulatory issues associated with filings for the purpose of identifying trends, problems, or deviations from pertinent regulatory requirements or Commission policies and developing recommendations to resolve issues for use by the team leader or supervisor.In the Office of Enforcement and Regulatory Accounting (OERA), Student Trainee (EIAs) assist in the analysis of electric and gas markets, assessing market fundamentals and trends, as well as complex issues related to market structure, conduct, and performance. Trainees analyze and develop large volumes of data using Python, SQL, R, Databricks, Posit, PowerBI, and/or CoPilot, working independently to summarize anomalous market outcomes and visually present data. A trainee more focused on data engineering may support enhancing data workflows, streamlining operational processes, and improving analytical efficiency by developing data pipelines, automation tools, ETL workflows, cloud based analytics infrastructure, and other technical components that enable OERA's analytical functions.The intern program at FERC is unique in that we post one intern vacancy for multiple offices to make selections. This means you may be contacted by several different hiring managers for different vacancies.

jobs.description: Employer: Pursuit of Innovation ("Pi515") Expires: 11/23/2026 Teaching Assistant - College InternFocus: Tech Mentorship ProgramLevel: College InternSalary: $20 per hour.Who we are:At Pi515, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every student to shape a better and more equitable society. Our team is composed of dedicated professionals who are passionate about making a positive impact. We are on a mission to challenge, inspire, and teach technology skills to students, particularly those from refugee and underserved backgrounds. By doing so, we empower these young individuals to achieve personal, academic, and professional success. We are more than just an organization; we are a community committed to building a brighter future. By joining our team, you will be part of a dynamic and supportive environment where you can make a real difference. About the role:As a Teaching Assistant (TA) for the Pi515 Tech Mentorship Program, you will play a crucial role in shaping the curriculum and supporting high school students as they learn to code using Python. You will be responsible for creating, updating, and providing feedback on the program's assignments, and assessments while making adjustments and improvements to the existing curriculum. Additionally, you will maintain regular communication with students, organize in-person and virtual classes, and collaborate with our team to ensure the program's success. This role requires self-motivation, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working with youth. Overview of the Tech Mentorship Program:The Pi515 Tech Mentorship Program runs from September to March, offering high school students the opportunity to learn how to code using Python. Led by experienced professionals from our corporate partners who volunteer their time, the program provides hands-on training and real-life learning experiences. Upon completion, students earn 3 college credits from DMACC, empowering them with valuable skills and knowledge to succeed in their educational journey. Work Schedule: 10-15 hours per week divided between our Des Moines office, program locations, and remote work. Availability required for on-site presence from 3:30-5:00 PM on Tuesdays and Thursdays.Responsibilities:Creating, reviewing, and updating assignments and assessmentsGrading and providing feedbackCommunicate with students on potential concerns, including attendance, assignment/assessment submissions, falling behind, etc. (Will work with program Coordinator)Attending in-person classes (twice/week)Co-lead virtual/in-person classesThis job might be for you if you have…A high school diploma and current enrollment in collegeA valid driver’s license and reliable transportationProficiency with Python (comparable to a semester-long college course)A passion for working with youthExcellent written and verbal communication skillsThe ability to multitaskSelf-motivation and independenceYou might be a fit for Pi515 if…You thrive on taking action and getting things accomplished (Action Oriented)You appreciate diversity and embrace the opportunity to broaden your knowledge through interactions with people from various backgrounds (cross-cultural awareness)You take ownership of your work and strive for continuous improvement (Operations Excellence) You are flexible and resilient, able to adjust quickly to new situations and circumstances (Adaptability)You are someone who thrives on challenges and constantly seeks learning opportunities for personal development. (Willingness to learn)What we offer: Flexible Schedule averaging to 10 hours/weekMix of remote and on-site workCasual dress codePurpose-driven culture Overview of the Tech Mentorship Program:The Pi515 Tech Mentorship Program runs from September to March, offering high school students the opportunity to learn how to code using Python. Led by experienced professionals from our corporate partners who volunteer their time, the program provides hands-on training and real-life learning experiences. Upon completion, students earn 3 college credits from DMACC, empowering them with valuable skills and knowledge to succeed in their educational journey. Our mission is to create opportunities for a brighter future by providing comprehensive education and valuable work experience with fair compensation. By nurturing their talents, we are fostering a community of empowered, confident, and self-sufficient youth, ready to make a positive impact in the world.Pi515 is committed to creating an inclusive and supportive environment for all students and staff. jobs.description: Employer: Air Force Civilian Service - Air Force Civilian Service Expires: 11/23/2026 PREMIER COLLEGE INTERN PROGRAM (PCIP)AFCS's full-time PCIP prepares college students for a number of promising career fields within AFCS, including Science and Engineering, Cybersecurity, IT, Acquisition, and other mission-critical specialty positions. Numerous internships in 45 locations across America will be awarded to qualified students. Some of our career fields even offer a sign-on bonus.Over the 10 to 12 week paid summer internship, you'll work side by side with current AFCS and military professionals, gaining invaluable hands-on experience and making tangible contributions to real-world projects in support of the Department of the Air Force and its critical mission. We'll help you tap into your creativity and ambition to tackle challenges, both known and unforeseen.Following college graduation and completion of PCIP, you may qualify for a full-time, paid position within one of AFCS's comprehensive training programs, where you'll further hone your expertise and specialized skillsets through either PALACE ACQUIRE (PAQ), which prepares students for a wide range of careers from Science and Engineering to Cyber and IT, or COPPER CAP (COP), which readies students to become Contract (procurement) Specialists.Once the program is successfully completed, you'll be placed into a professional-level position at AFCS, where you'll receive federal health and retirement benefits, tuition assistance toward a graduate degree while in the PAQ Program, repayment of student loans for those who qualify, and a generous Recruitment Bonus for certain positions.The future will be here before you know it. The Premier College Intern Program will ensure you're ready when it arrives.

jobs.title: Intern, Construction Lending at Invitation Homes
jobs.description: Employer: Invitation Homes Expires: 11/23/2026 Job DescriptionWho We AreInvitation Homes is a fast-paced, publicly traded REIT that is pioneering a new industry with over 110,000 single-family rental homes owned and managed and a market capitalization of over $20 billion. As the nation’s premier home leasing company, we are looking for students serious about kickstarting their career alongside our passionate and collaborative associates. We are looking for dynamic students to join our 2027 summer internship program.The RoleInvitation Homes 10-week paid summer internship is the first step in building a career as an Investment Management Group (IMG) associate. This is an opportunity for personal and professional development, community outreach, and other meaningful intern specific events.The BTR Construction Lending Intern role is a unique opportunity to learn the construction loan origination, underwriting, and portfolio management process firsthand. Required QualificationsProficiency in the MS Office Suite, particularly ExcelExperience utilizing a technical skill (e.g., Excel, AI, Python, Tableau, SQL, etc.) through coursework, personal initiatives, or previous employment is preferred but not requiredStrong analytical mindset, eagerness to learn technical tools, excellent communication and organizational skills, and the ability to adapt, problem-solve, and collaborate effectivelyDesire to work in Dallas, TexasEducation/Certifications:Rising senior or grad student pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree from an accredited university in Finance, Real Estate, Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or other related fields with an expected graduation date between December 2028 and May 2028 Why Invitation HomesWe believe when our residents thrive, our associates thrive. jobs.description: Employer: Northrop Grumman Corporation Expires: 11/23/2026 Internship opportunities at Northrop Grumman are unique. jobs.title: Food Safety & Quality Internship at Ardent Mills
jobs.description: Employer: Ardent Mills Expires: 11/23/2026 Job DescriptionArdent Mills is committed to transforming how the world is nourished. As the premier flour-milling and ingredient company, we cultivate the future of plant-based solutions to help our customers and communities thrive. Ardent Mills is looking for curious, ambitious individuals who want to grow their global and local impact, career, and leadership skills.Flourish is Ardent Mill’s summer Intern Program, structured and designed to provide a foundational understanding of how to live Ardent Mills' values while gaining hands-on experience in the industry through specialized projects. The intent of our intern program is to hire into full-time positions as people-leaders within operations.Interns will be immersed in day-to-day business activity while collaborating directly with leaders across the organization in a group project experience. Interns will also work on individual projects, assigned based on organizational need. A variety of social and business-related activities are also available for further interaction and networking amongst peers and leaders.Food Safety & Quality InternshipFood Safety & Quality Interns will gain exposure to the broader operations within Ardent Mills, with a keen focus on food safety and quality, gaining the skills and knowledge required to conduct testing and utilize our Ardent Mills Food Safety and Quality Policies in decision making. Our objective is to expose interns to diverse operational challenges, broaden their experience in a food manufacturing setting, and develop a network of resources.Principal Accountabilities:Areas of exposure may include, but are not limited to:Participate in toolbox meetings and department reviews to ensure that work is properly integrated, and that progress is on trackPromotes personnel and food safety, ensuring a safe work environment and employee work habitsSupport and abide by plant rules within the workplaceEssential Functions/Requirements:Ability to perform work in inclement weather conditions (hot and cold)Candidate must be physically able to climb ladders and stairsWilling to work periodic workdays more than assigned work scheduleEducation, Experience, Skills:Majoring in Milling Science, Bakery Science, Ag Studies, Business, Food Science, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biosystems Engineering, or related studies Strong computer skillsStrong written and oral communication skillsProblem solving skillsOrganization/Time Management skillsStrong analytical skillsA willingness to take on responsibilities and challengesOther considerations:Must be authorized to work in the Unites states without sponsorship now and in the future Except where prohibited by law, all offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test and pre-employment background check

jobs.title: Internship Accounting / QuickBooks / Payroll Specialist (Paid) at Complete Construction Co.
jobs.description: Employer: Complete Construction Co. Expires: 11/23/2026 We offer hours/credits towards your internship. Let us know what program you are in and we will put together a plan to help you gain the experience you need. Interns must be reliable, trustworthy, and professional. Most of the work will be assisting Project Managers on current projects with accounting/payroll related duties. SUBMIT YOUR INTEREST NOW BY FILLING IN THIS APPLICATION:https://forms.gle/3vsMtvFAKZVE8Shn6If you have a resume, email it to CompleteConstructionCo@gmail.com to let us know you've submitted your application. EDUCATION REQUIREMENT:MUST be learning Quickbooks or know how to use Quickbooks Online.Business, Finance, Bookkeeping or accounting majorWORKING ENVIRONMENT:Onsite in our construction office in Brentwood (Zip code: 94513).Daily Duties:Answer questions from vendors, employees, and customers about their bills, paychecks, and invoices.Pick up and drop off paychecks - make sure pay checks are sent in time.Perform misc office-related duties as assigned.We are a small company, each employee contributes a lot and is their own dept responsible for tasks that do not overlap with other depts.KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:Excellent knowledge of computers and the Internet.Work fluently with Microsoft Office, email, browsers, Windows operating systems, and PCs.Ability and knack for working with numerical data.Attention to detail. Accurate.Solid understanding of the three levels of QuickBooks Online applicationKnowledge of double-entry bookkeeping is preferred but not required.Knowledge of business and accounting terms such as profit, ROI, assets, liabilities, etc.Ability to effectively manage time, meet deadlines, and work under pressure.Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.Knowledge of general office procedures, such as copying, faxing, filing, and shredding.Innovative and creative in the form of continuous improvement to internal processes.Flexible and adaptable to change.SUMMARY:Under general supervision, create and maintain the accounting records for the company using the QuickBooks Online applications.Assist the accounting department manager or owner in running and customizing reports that provide business analysis and results. Perform banking functions as required.DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:General Setup and Accounting Records:• Create and maintain vendor records, including contact information, payment terms, and any other information required.• Create and maintain customer records including contact, delivery and payment information.• Customize the company invoice form and other forms, such as sales receipts and estimates (Plus only) as needed.• Create and maintain employees including contact information, payroll salary or rate information, and related employment data, such as W-4s and other new hire paperwork.Transactions:• Manage bills received from vendors.• Create and maintain time tracking records, if applicable.• Prepare estimates if requested.• If estimates are used, match invoices to estimates. If time tracking is used, tie to invoicing.• Record bank transactions as needed. Download bank transactions into bank accounts• Prepare or monitor the preparation of payroll.

jobs.title: College Intern at City of Roseville - Electric Department
jobs.description: Employer: City of Roseville - Electric Department Expires: 11/23/2026 The City of Roseville is pleased to offer valuable paid internship opportunities for current college students seeking to gain professional experience in public service. This internship provides a structured environment where students can apply academic knowledge, develop essential workplace skills, and contribute to impactful projects that benefit the community. FOR FIRST CONSIDERATION, PLEASE APPLY BY DECEMBER 1, 2026 @ 11:59PMTHIS JOB POSTING CLOSES ON FEBRUARY 7, 2027 OR THE FIRST 400 APPLICANTS This position is limited to no more than 40 hours per week and no more than 1000 hours per fiscal year. The work schedule and hours are flexible, Monday through Friday, between 8:00 am and 5:00 pm.Current positions are available in the following departments:Electric Transmission & Distribution EngineeringElectric Power Plant EngineeringEnvironmental Utilities Information TechnologyAnd more as available! The Environmental Utilities Department is looking for motivated college students interested in pursuing a career in the water and wastewater industry who have a passion for public service. Ideal candidates are curious, eager to learn, take initiative, and are interested in gaining hands-on experience supporting infrastructure projects that serve our community.The City of Roseville’s Electric Department is responsible for supplying power to over 75,000 customers. The transmission and distribution engineering group handles all design, analysis, and operational support for the City's 18 substations, 12kV and 60kV distribution systems. The power plant engineering division is responsible for all aspects of engineering work related to designing, operating and maintaining the City’s three natural gas power plants.The City of Roseville is committed to an inclusive and supportive workforce and workplace. jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Intern - Supply Chain Planning at Nintendo of America Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Nintendo of America Inc. Expires: 11/23/2026 Nintendo of America About Nintendo of America: From the launch of the Nintendo Entertainment System™ more than 30 years ago, Nintendo’s mission has been to create smiles through unique entertainment experiences. Here at Nintendo of America Inc., we deliver on this mission by partnering closely with Nintendo Co., Ltd., to bring Nintendo’s iconic and cherished franchises including Mario™, Donkey Kong™, The Legend of Zelda™, Metroid™, Animal Crossing™, Pikmin™ and Splatoon™ across the Americas through our video games, hardware systems, and collaborations with partners on a range of other entertainment initiatives like feature films and theme parks. We are an equal opportunity employer offering a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our products, and the diverse consumers and communities we call home. For more information about Nintendo, please visit the company’s website at https://www.nintendo.com/. GET SERIOUS ABOUT FUN As a Nintendo of America intern, you will actively contribute to meaningful projects and gain valuable hands-on work experience with a leading company in the entertainment industry. During the program from June through August, your work experience will be enhanced with mentoring, networking opportunities, and exposure to industry leaders from across the company! Whether you are in a technical or non-technical role, you will be part of a team committed to putting smiles on the faces of millions around the world. Application deadline is December 1, 2026. DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES Partner with Nintendo’s Supply Chain Planning team to launch a secure file transfer protocol (SFTP) between the enterprise resource planning (ERP) and transportation management systems (TMS), streamlining purchase order line-level shipment confirmation. Develop training guides for suppliers and Nintendo teams affected by the process change. Coordinate change management efforts with internal stakeholders. SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENTS 3.0+ GPA. Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university with a graduation conferral date between May 2027 and June 2028. Pursuing a degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics & Supply Chain Management, Transportation and Logistics, Project Management, or related field. Knowledge of Supply Chain and Inventory Management Principles (procurement, logistics, production, and distribution operations). Familiarity with project management. Knowledge of scheduling shipments for distribution centers and service providers. Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Familiarity with retrieving and analyzing data using TMS, Excel, and other data management tools. Knowledge of Warehouse Management System, ERP Applications and Transportation Management System. Legally authorized to work in the United States. Able to work 40 hours a week onsite throughout the course of the 10-week summer internship between June 14 – August 20. Applicants must be legally eligible to work in the United States to be considered. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. This position is 100% onsite in Redmond, WA. This internship includes the base pay rate listed below, paid sick and holiday time, and perks such as a local transit pass and access to the onsite fitness center. Given the limited duration of the role, interns are not eligible for full-time employee benefits such as healthcare or 401(k). Pay Rate: $30 - $30 USD

About Bread Financial®At Bread Financial, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community, and be part of our award-winning culture. We’ve been consistently recognized as a best place to work nationally and in many markets and we’re proud to promote an environment where you feel appreciated, accepted, valued, and fulfilled—both personally and professionally. Bread Financial supports the overall wellness of our associates with a diverse suite of benefits and offers boundless opportunities for career development and non-traditional career progression. Bread Financial® (NYSE: BFH) is a tech-forward financial services company that provides simple, personalized payment, lending and saving solutions to millions of U.S. consumers. Our payment solutions deliver growth for some of the most recognized brands in travel & entertainment, health & beauty, technology, electronics, jewelry, home and specialty apparel through our co-brand and private label credit cards and pay-over-time products providing choice and value to our shared customers. jobs.description: Employer: CSpring Expires: 11/24/2026 Build the relationship and communication skills that drive business growth. CSpring is seeking summer 2027 interns for our Catalyst program. You’ll gain hands-on recruiting experience at an Indianapolis technology consulting and data analytics firm, with coaching from leaders who work across recruiting, sales, and marketing. This internship is focused on recruiting. You’ll learn how to find talent, start meaningful conversations, understand what candidates are looking for, and help connect people with the right opportunities. It’s practical experience for someone interested in a future career in sales, marketing, recruiting, or business development. What You’ll Do Research and identify prospective candidates for technology and consulting rolesWrite thoughtful outreach that gives people a reason to respondBuild relationships with candidates through conversations and follow-upConduct initial screens to learn about candidates’ experience, interests, and goalsKeep accurate notes and manage candidate activity in recruiting systemsShare what you’re learning about the talent market with the teamWork with recruiters and CSpring leaders to improve the candidate experience What You’ll Gain You’ll receive mentorship, professional coaching, and experience with modern tools. You’ll practice skills that carry into many business careers: outreach, interviewing, relationship building, professional writing, and learning from market feedback. Strong performance may lead to consideration for future opportunities at CSpring! We’re looking for people who bring energy and engagement to their work. You may be a fit if you:Are driven to set goals, make progress, and see resultsHave a competitive streak and enjoy working toward a high standardLike meeting people, asking good questions, and building relationshipsTake initiative, follow through, and welcome coachingCommunicate clearly and stay resilient when things don’t go as plannedCurrent students and recent graduates interested in sales, marketing, recruiting, or other relationship-driven careers are encouraged to apply. Interested in learning how business relationships begin? Apply to join CSpring Catalyst.

jobs.title: Intern - Financial Risk at Bread Financial
jobs.description: Employer: Bread Financial Expires: 11/24/2026 Every career journey is personal. That's why we empower you with the tools and support to create your own success story. Be challenged. Be heard. Be valued. Be you ... be here. Job SummaryThe Summer Internship Program at Bread Financial allows college students to develop a variety of skills within different areas of our business. Over the summer, interns will collaborate with several teams and departments, building a firm knowledge of our business and company culture. Participants will also go through a professional curriculum, attend social and philanthropic events, and participate in executive round tables. The program targets rising junior and senior undergraduate students and graduate students.The Financial Risk team provides enterprise risk oversight for critical processes related to liquidity, capital, market, strategic, and model risk. Interns will gain exposure to risk oversight of the banks’ funding programs, including the related controls, analysis, and reporting. Interns will work with Bread Financial subsidiaries and collaborate with internal and external business leaders across Treasury, Finance, Accounting, and Strategy.Responsibilities may include:-Analysis and Reporting: Support the Financial Risk team by analyzing data related to cash flow movements, liquidity, interest rates, capital, and other financial risk areas. Review reports and calculations to help confirm the accuracy and integrity of underlying processes.-Documentation and Execution: Assist with preparing workpapers, reports, and other deliverables that document key risks, controls, analysis, and conclusions. Develop an understanding of external events and emerging economic risks that may affect the business.-Governance and Oversight: Learn the fundamentals of enterprise risk management and support a proactive risk and control culture through monitoring, review, and effective challenge.-Risk Assessments and Management Reviews: Assist with risk assessments, management reviews, and other oversight activities across Financial Risk programs.-Ad Hoc Support: Complete data analysis, department updates, and other projects based on team and business needs. Essential Job FunctionsGaining an understanding of the associate’s related area of the enterprise and completion of role-specific training provided by their respective team. jobs.feedName: David Nazarian College of Business & Economics
jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineering Co-op at Alliance Laundry Systems, LLC
jobs.description: Employer: Alliance Laundry Systems, LLC Expires: 11/24/2026 Join Our Team as a Supplier Quality Engineering Co-op! Timing/Duration of Internship/Co-op: Spring/Summer 2027 Co-Op (January to August) or, Summer/Fall 2027 Co-Op (May to December))Ripon, WI — on-site, 1st shift. Most of what goes into a finished product is made by someone else. Do you want to learn how a company makes sure those parts are right — and what happens when they are not? Join our Supplier Quality team in Ripon, WI, as a Supplier Quality Engineering Co-op. Working alongside our Supplier Quality Engineers, you will help qualify new parts, support investigations into supplier issues, and see how a supply base is managed. Why Join Us? Broad Exposure: Support part qualification, supplier audits, and corrective action work across multiple commodities. Real-World Impact: Contribute to qualifications and investigations that continue after your term ends. Professional Development: Learn PPAP, APQP, supplier auditing, and root cause investigation from engineers who do it every day. Supplier quality runs on timelines that do not fit in a summer. A co-op term is long enough to follow those cycles from start to close. Apply now. Your Role: Support the qualification of assigned parts or a commodity group, including helping prepare and review PPAP submissions. Help track open supplier quality issues and assist the team in following them through to resolution. Assist with investigations into non-conforming material, supporting root cause analysis and the documentation of Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs). Participate in supplier audits and technical reviews alongside your mentor, observing how quality systems and process capability are evaluated. Help compile supplier KPIs such as defects per million and on-time delivery, and prepare reject and warranty summaries for the management team. Support APQP activities and assist Design and Manufacturing Engineering with clarifying component specifications and tolerances. What We're Looking For: Skills and Abilities: Problem-solving ability paired with diplomacy and professionalism when communicating with supplier contacts. Blueprint reading ability, or readiness to learn it quickly, including the ability to interpret standards such as ASTM. Functional understanding of statistics as applied to quality, or coursework underway. Strong computer skills, including Excel; familiarity with SAP, Minitab, or Power BI is a plus. Willingness to ask questions and seek direction from your mentor and the broader Quality team. Education: Currently pursuing an associate or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain, with sophomore standing or above, and eligible for a multi-term co-op through your school. Physical Requirements: The role involves a mix of sitting for extended periods, standing and walking the production floor, stooping, bending, and minimal lifting. Manual dexterity is also required. Occasional day or overnight travel to domestic supplier sites may be part of this role, always accompanied by your mentor. International travel is not required. Ready to see how the supply base really works? Apply now to join our Supplier Quality team!

jobs.description: Employer: PepsiCo Expires: 11/24/2026 Nationwide Opportunities- Please Read: Although this posting may appear to be tied to a specific location (e.g., Purchase, NY), placements for this role are nationwide and assigned based on business needs across various field locations. This is a fully field-based role and will not involve a remote or corporate office setting. SMILE AT WHAT’S NEXT At PepsiCo, you'll find the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and help shape what's next. As one of the world's leading food and beverage companies, our beloved brands—including Gatorade, Lay's, and Quaker—help create smiles with every sip and bite. Behind our products is a connected system that starts with how we source and grow ingredients alongside farmers and extends to how we make, move, and deliver products while driving positive impact for our business and communities. At the heart of PepsiCo are our people: professionals who bring curiosity, drive, and fresh thinking, working together to turn ideas into action. Across functions, teams, and markets, we collaborate to solve challenges, unlock new opportunities, and create meaningful impact for our consumers, customers, and communities. No matter your role, you'll be part of a connected community where your contributions matter, your voice is heard, and your development is supported. With opportunities to grow, belong, and smile, PepsiCo offers more than a place to build your career—it offers the chance to help create what's next.ResponsibilitiesFunctional Description: PepsiCo’s Field Sales internship offers a fast-paced, hands-on environment where learning by doing is the norm. Does leading a team of 8-10 sales reps within your first two years excite you? Does spearheading a $10-15 million business sound rewarding? If so, PepsiCo Field Sales might be the organization for you! You'll gain firsthand exposure to sales operations, route execution, team collaboration, and leadership. You will work alongside experienced Field Sales Leaders and gain visibility with senior leadership. jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer Intern at Alliance Laundry Systems, LLC
jobs.description: Employer: Alliance Laundry Systems, LLC Expires: 11/24/2026 Supplier Quality Engineering Intern Location: Ripon, WI Timing: Summer 2027 Internship Overview We are seeking a curious and detail-oriented Supplier Quality Engineering Intern to support our Quality team in Ripon, Wisconsin. This internship provides exposure to supplier quality management, part qualification, supplier performance data, and the cross-functional collaboration between Quality, Purchasing, and Engineering. The Supplier Quality Engineering Intern will assist with a defined summer project scoped by a mentor, support day-to-day supplier quality activities, and contribute to work that improves how we evaluate and manage our supply base. What You'll Do Support a defined summer project assigned by your mentor, such as helping build a supplier performance scorecard, assisting with a PPAP submission package, or documenting a root cause investigation on a recurring non-conformance. Help analyze supplier performance data — defects per million, on-time delivery, reject and warranty trends — in Excel and SAP, and assist in preparing summaries for the management team. Sit in on supplier audits and technical reviews, virtual and on-site at regional suppliers, and observe how a supplier's quality management system is evaluated. Learn how a Supplier Corrective Action Request (SCAR) is written, issued, and closed, and help maintain the supporting documentation. Observe the APQP process and how launch readiness is assessed before a new part is approved. Help compare supplier process capability data against print requirements and flag gaps for the team to review. Read technical drawings and material standards such as ASTM, and learn what a specification is really asking for. Share your project findings and observations with the Quality and Sourcing teams at the end of the term. What You'll Bring Currently pursuing an associate or bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or a related field, with sophomore standing or above. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills, including professionalism when communicating with contacts outside the company. Ability to gather information, ask thoughtful questions, and work through unfamiliar processes. Comfortable using Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel; familiarity with SAP, Power BI, Minitab, or SharePoint is a plus. Ability to follow direction while collaborating effectively with teammates across functions and locations. Interest in manufacturing, quality, supply chain, sourcing, or supplier development. Key Competencies Acquires Information: Gathers data from multiple sources, consults with others, and asks effective questions to support assigned work. Communicates Effectively: Clearly and concisely shares information while tailoring communication to the needs of the audience. Supports Coworkers: Responds positively to requests, contributes to team goals, and considers the impact of their work on others. What You'll Gain Hands-on exposure to how a part goes from a drawing to an approved, qualified, shipping component. Experience supporting PPAP, APQP, supplier auditing, and SCAR/CAPA processes. Understanding of what a quality management system audit looks for and why ISO and IATF certification matter. Opportunities to develop data analysis, professional communication, and teamwork skills. A dedicated engineering mentor, regular check-ins, and access to the full Quality team. Physical Requirements and Travel The role involves a mix of sitting for extended periods, standing and walking the production floor, stooping, bending, and minimal lifting. Manual dexterity is also required. Occasional day travel to regional supplier sites may be available as a learning opportunity, always accompanied by your mentor. No overnight or international travel is required.

Ability to cope well in stressful environments and communicate professionally.Willingness to work independently within in a team environment and assist the team with other duties as required. jobs.title: Associate Consultant Intern, 2027 – Warsaw, Poland at Mastercard
jobs.description: Employer: Mastercard Expires: 11/26/2026 Associate Consultant Intern, 2027 – Warsaw, PolandLocation Warsaw, Poland, 02-738Category OtherJob Type Full timeJob Id R-287716Our PurposeMastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.Title and SummaryAssociate Consultant Intern, 2027 – Warsaw, PolandWhy join Mastercard’s internship program?Mastercard's internship program offers more than hands-on work. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities.About the teamMastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.What you’ll doAs an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.You will:- Work in small teams to support strategic consulting projects across industries - Collaborate with colleagues across different areas of the organization and gain exposure to business development, account management, and product management- Analyze data, identify trends, and help translate insights into recommendations- Create clear and compelling presentations for internal teams and clients- Support problem solving by structuring challenges and exploring solutions- Build an understanding of how consulting engagements are delivered end to end- Participate in volunteer and team building experiences- Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series- Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions- Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management teamSpecialization TracksWe are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting three specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.Strategy & TransformationGuide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:- How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?- How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?Performance AnalyticsUse quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:- How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?- How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?MarketingDevelop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:- How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?- How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?- How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?What we’re looking for:- Final-year Master’s students expected to graduate by September 2027.- Available to work between 1st February - 30th July 2027- Polish and English fluency (minimum C1) is expected; non-Polish speakers can also be considered if fluent in English plus working proficiency in one other European language.- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and excellent communication will set you up to thrive here.We recruit for and value the following core competencies:Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks).Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.As an intern, you'll benefit from- Mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals and leaders- Networking opportunities with fellow interns, employees, and senior leaders- Professional development experiences focused on career growth and skill-building- Exposure to innovative technologies and global business challenges- Volunteer, community engagement, and team-building activities- Many of our interns continue building their careers with Mastercard through full-time opportunities, early career programs, or future internships.To participate in our job simulation and experience what it’s like to work as a Consultant at Mastercard visit: https://www.theforage.com/simulations/mastercard/advisors-client-services-xvlwCorporate Security ResponsibilityAll activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;Report any suspected information security violation or breach, andComplete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.description: Employer: Procter & Gamble (P&G) Expires: 11/26/2026 Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. The Opportunity:P&G has an opportunity for a PhD intern to work in our Corporate R&D to develop an AI-agent-driven framework that automates and accelerates machine learning experimentation for time-series data modeling. The intern will explore how AI agents can propose and execute experiments, modify configurations or code, analyze results, and recommend next steps. Key Responsibilities:Review existing literature and techniques in LLM-based AI agents, automated machine learning, and AI-enabled research systems.Prepare time-series datasets and establish a reliable, reproducible baseline model and evaluation pipeline.Design and implement an AI-agent-driven framework for proposing, executing, and analyzing machine learning experiments.Explore improvements in data preprocessing, feature representation, model architecture, training strategies, and hyperparameter selection.Implement appropriate validation, experiment-tracking, and reproducibility practices for AI-generated configurations or code.Compare AI-enabled and conventional experimentation approaches based on model performance, reproducibility, experiment throughput, and research efficiency.Document the framework, experiments, results, limitations, and recommendations.Share key insights and present final results to the broader R&D team. Available to work 5 days a week in office at Mason, OH location. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with large language models, generative AI, and the design of multi-step agentic workflows or multi-agent systems.Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph and AI observability platforms such as Arize.Experience with automated machine learning, hyperparameter optimization, experiment orchestration, or experiment-tracking systems.Experience in time-series data modeling.A record of research contributions through grants, fellowships, patents, peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, or relevant open-source projects. jobs.description: Employer: Novogradac & Company LLP Expires: 11/26/2026 Dare to bring your unique perspective?At Novogradac, we value individuals who bring unique perspectives and bold ideas. If you’re eager to contribute to an inclusive, innovative environment where your personal and professional growth is encouraged and supported, we invite you to explore this exciting opportunity with us. Novogradac is hiring Staff Accountant Interns to explore our firm for busy season 2027 (January 2027 through the end of March 2027). Our trendsetting interns learn hands-on what it takes to be a staff accountant for a growing national CPA firm by tackling a variety of different assignments, including audit, tax preparation and research. Novogradac believes in giving our interns a real-life business experience and compensating you well while you’re here. jobs.description: Employer: United States Golf Association Expires: 11/26/2026 The USGA is a mission-based golf organization whose purpose is to unify the golf community through handicapping and grassroots programs; to showcase the game’s best talent through the U.S. Open, U.S. Women’s Open and 13 other national championships and our museum; to provide unbiased global governance with The R&A through the playing, equipment and Amateur Status rules; and to advance issues important to golf’s future, with a focus on driving sustainability, accessibility and inclusion. As a nonprofit association, our work and our team are driven to act for the good of the game. The USGA’s headquarters are located in Liberty Corner, NJ, with a recently opened campus in Pinehurst, NC. For more, visit usga.org. This application process will be used to consider candidates for short-term hospitality support roles at the 2027 U.S. Open at Pebble Beach Golf Links and the 2027 U.S. Women’s Open at Inverness Club. A limited number of applicants may be selected to support both championships. More information about championship assignments will be communicated throughout the interview process.About this role:Corporate hospitality is an important part of the championship experience, providing companies, clients, partners, and guests with premium spaces to engage throughout the week. This role supports the behind-the-scenes execution of these venues while giving interns hands-on exposure to planning, client management, hospitality operations, and the many USGA departments involved in championship execution. jobs.title: Summer 2027 Mars Snacking Manufacturing Internship - Muncy, PA at Mars, Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Mars, Inc. Expires: 11/26/2026 At Mars, we work together to build a better world for people, pets, and the planet. From being a socially responsible business, to investing in our Associates, we're always looking at how we can make tomorrow brighter. As an Associate, you are empowered with the freedom and tools to be yourself, to forge your own path, to build relationships across our global community, to discover the right opportunities for you to grow – all with ample support. Here, you have our ongoing commitment to your growth and development as you work across our world-famous brands. Start your journey at Mars today! Mars Snacking Manufacturing Internship Experience As a Mars Snacking Manufacturing Intern, you will gain exposure to the following areas: Direct involvement in a fast-paced, food manufacturing environment Understanding of success factors for Safety, Quality, and Continuous Improvement in a manufacturing setting Cross-functional project leadership developing and implementing solutions to increase efficiency in a food processing or packaging area What we’re looking for: Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Eligible candidates will intern the summer prior to their final graduation date. Open to students legally authorized to work in the U.S., without the need for current or future work status authorization or visa sponsorship for employment. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of drug & background screening. Eligible candidates will be responsible for personal transportation to and from work site during duration of the internship program. What can you expect from Mars? The Mars Internship Experience is a 10–11-week summer program providing excellent depth of experience with real business problems and opportunities. Exciting professional and social engagement activities throughout the experience that provide opportunities to network with your intern peers all the way up to senior leaders. Best-in-class training and development from Day 1, including a formal mentor, access to our in-house Mars University, and more. Ongoing coaching and mentorship to help you succeed and get the most out of your experience. Some pretty sweet perks including competitive salary & benefits package, fun freebies. Location in Muncy, PA at our Pop Tart / Nutri-grain manufacturing facility. About Mars, Incorporated For more than a century, Mars, Incorporated has been driven by the belief that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today. This idea is at the center of who we have always been as a global, family-owned business. Today, Mars is transforming, innovating, and evolving in ways that affirm our commitment to making a positive impact on the world around us. Across our diverse and expanding portfolio of Confectionery, Food, and Petcare products and services, we employ over 140,000 dedicated Associates who are all moving in the same direction: forward. With $40 billion in annual sales, we produce some of the world’s best-loved brands including DOVE®, EXTRA®, M&M’S®, MILKY WAY®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, ORBIT®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL™, WHISKAS®, COCOAVIA®, and 5™; and take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses, including AniCura, Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, and VCA™. We know we can only be truly successful if our partners and the communities in which we operate prosper as well. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our Associates to take action every day to help create a world tomorrow in which the planet, its people and pets can thrive. The Mars Compass, inspired by the Economics of Mutuality, is used to measure the company’s progress in service of its purpose; The world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today. For more information about Mars, please visit mars.com. Join us on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

jobs.description: Employer: Altitude Promotions Expires: 11/26/2026 The Sales & Marketing Internship at Altitude Promotions offers a fast-paced, hands-on introduction to the world of B2B sales and marketing. Interns gain real-world experience representing Fortune 500 clients, managing professional relationships with business owners, and learning how to drive revenue growth through strategic marketing and sales initiatives. As part of being an intern at Altitude Promotions, interns will work closely with various teams across the company — including Sales, Public Relations, and Human Resources — to gain a full understanding of how different departments operate together to achieve company goals. Interns start by learning the fundamentals of sales: building client relationships, communicating value, and developing confidence through direct interaction with businesses. However, the goal isn’t to stay in sales — it’s to use that experience as a launchpad for growth into broader roles in marketing, management, or leadership. Altitude Promotions emphasizes personal and professional development, helping interns strengthen their communication, teamwork, and strategic skills so they can transition into positions that align with their long-term career ambitions. Key ResponsibilitiesRepresent Fortune 500 clients in direct sales and marketing campaigns.Develop and implement marketing strategies tailored to local and regional markets.Generate leads, qualify prospects, and close sales through effective relationship-building and communication.Collaborate with senior leadership to analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities for increased sales.Adapt to a dynamic and competitive environment while maintaining professionalism and a client-focused approach.Contribute to team success by sharing strategies, supporting peers, and demonstrating initiative. Skills GainedSales & Negotiation: Learn how to identify client needs, present value-driven solutions, and close deals effectively.Marketing Strategy: Gain experience developing creative campaigns that connect major brands with small businessesStrategic Communication: Build trust through persuasive presentations and targeted messaging.Leadership & Teamwork: Thrive in a results-oriented team environment and demonstrate growth potential.Adaptability: Adjust to evolving client goals and market trends with agility and confidence. This position provides full exposure to the sales and marketing cycle — from lead generation and outreach to campaign development and execution. It’s an opportunity to build key skills in communication, adaptability, leadership, and client management while working directly with senior executives and corporate partners.

jobs.description: Employer: EisnerAmper Expires: 11/26/2026 At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals. What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper: You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions What you’ll be doing: As an Assurance intern you will have the opportunity to work on various aspects of a financial statement audit to develop a working knowledge of the firm’s practices in our Assurance practice. Students will learn systems, and business processes. An internship with us gives the student an opportunity to combine knowledge gained in the classroom with company training and develop on-the-job technical skills while working as part of a team carrying out tasks under close coaching and supervision.Interns work directly with our seasoned professionals on client engagements rather than being assigned “busy work.” Our internship experience provides valuable insight into the public accounting industry, gives interns real world experience to apply to school knowledge, and affords the tools and resources needed to hit the ground running as a first-year associate upon college graduation. We’re looking for someone who has: We are currently looking for winter internship professionals to join us in Winter 2027. This is a full-time internship that will start early January 2027. Live in commutable distance to your assigned office Have the availability to work in office for 40+ hours per week during business hours (business hours: 8:30am – 5:30pm; Monday – Friday) Basic Qualifications: Must be currently pursuing the following degrees/majors: Bachelors and/or Master's degree in accounting, or equivalent program from an accredited college or university 0-2 years recent public accounting experience Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future Preferred/Desired Qualifications: Pursuing minimum educational requirements for CPA licensure (which may differ from the educational requirements to sit for the CPA exam) in the state of your assigned office location Pursuing 150 academic credits or master's degree in accounting, or equivalent program from an accredited college or university Final Graduation Date of Dec 2027 – Sept 2028 Strong academic track record (Minimum GPA: 3.0) Strong MS Excel and MS Word Strong time management and organizational skills Strong work ethic with the ability to work independently and with a team Great communication, leadership, and analytical skills About our Assurance Team In the EisnerAmper Assurance Group, we’re transforming the traditional reputation of auditing. By operating on the core tenets of profound trust, professional integrity, and consistent results, we strive to create lasting partnerships with our clients based on solutions rather than simply identifying issues in their financial statements. To stay up to date with evolving industry processes and regulations, we place a heavy emphasis on continued education and the consistent adoption of new technologies. Because we understand trust comes with time, we define success by the relationships we create and foster. We act as a trusted business advisor every step of the way, from a client’s first financial report to their close of business. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today, and position them for success tomorrow. jobs.description: Employer: RESPEC Expires: 11/26/2026 Student Engineering Intern (Structural)Brookings, SD, USAInternshipDiscipline: Structural EngineeringCompany DescriptionBig challenges need bold thinkers.If you’re someone who sees problems as opportunities, you’ll thrive here. RESPEC is 100% employee-owned, which means we take ownership of every challenge. Here, your ideas drive real solutions. Since 1969, we’ve tackled complex challenges in energy transition, infrastructure resilience, digital transformation, and sustainability.At RESPEC, you’ll work alongside clients to take on critical problems. Depending on your expertise, you might design infrastructure in remote locations, develop renewable energy solutions for global projects, or apply data-driven technology to improve mining and water systems.We bring deep technical knowledge, real-world experience, and a commitment to work that matters. This is a temporary part-time position. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain real-world experience with a growing North American engineering consulting firm. This is a temporary part-time position. This hands-on design position is within RESPEC’s Facilities (Structural) Market Sector. This internship position will work alongside our firm’s full-time employees to learn how professional services are provided to our clients. Our experienced staff will provide mentoring and coaching to our interns to allow development of civil engineering skills and knowledge. Interns will get exposed to our clients, job sites, communities, as well as collaborate with our RESPEC multi-discipline team on public and private sector clients. Additional responsibilities include:Assist with design workPerform calculations and simulationsResearch topics as assignedAssist with field inspectionsQualificationsThe ideal candidate will have the following:Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in civil engineeringPreferred qualifications include the following:Solid time management skills and ability to produce accurate, high-quality work in an efficient mannerCoursework in steel, wood, concrete, and precast/prestressed concrete designGood working knowledge of fundamental of structural engineering conceptsSelf-motivated and detail-orientedStrong problem-solving and math skills Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writingTeam player who strives to provide quality workSome proficiency with Autocad RevitAdditional InformationCompensation: Compensation depends on experience. No benefits are offered except those that are required for statutory purposes.Work Schedule: During the summer months; 40 hours/week.

jobs.title: Case Resolution Specialist, Employee and Labor Relations | USC at JOB BOARD - Straus Institute and Graduate Law Programs
jobs.description: Employer: JOB BOARD - Straus Institute and Graduate Law Programs Expires: 11/26/2026 The Case Resolution Specialist (CRS) provides impartial consultation, conflict resolution, investigation, and problem solving in response to informal and formal complaints from various campus stakeholders. The CRS conducts inquiries, analysis, and case resolution; assists in the development/maintenance of relevant policies, training, procedures, and guidelines. The CRS is responsible for maintaining accurate, updated records and documentation in case management system. The CRS stays current with modern case resolution methods/best practices to resolve workplace concerns in a proactive manner.Hear from the Employee and Labor Relations teamListen to Valyncia Raphael-Woodward share more about the ELR team, the Case Resolution Specialist role, what makes the work meaningful, and what candidates can expect.Listen to the Role Overview → https://tinyurl.com/caseresolutionspecialist(opens in new window)The work schedule for this opportunity is hybrid, requiring three days onsite a week at our offices in Downtown Los Angeles.Job ResponsibilitiesThe candidate for the position of Case Resolution Specialist will:Conduct impartial, confidential trauma-informed interviews and fact-finding meetings to investigate formal and informal complaints and inquiries. Interview employees, collects appropriate documentation, reviews information from a variety of sources, and provides support as the case is facilitated to resolution, ensuring a well-documented and prompt process for all parties.Document and maintains employee and labor relations and workplace concerns in a case management system in a timely manner. Ensure all employee relations and workplace concerns are addressed.Develop and communicates results, corrective actions, and recommendations for appropriate resolutions to an array of complex workplace issues using a variety of tools (e.g., facilitated dialogue, shuttle diplomacy, other alternative dispute resolution methods). Draft, implement, and monitor informal resolution agreements.Provide outreach and training on matters related to resolving workplace concerns according to university policies, procedures, and processes to various audiences. May work in collaboration with other unit members to perform projects and conduct background research to assist with cases, training, and development of outreach and other programming materials.Assist with writing and maintaining employee policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures. Work to foster and maintain effective and collegial relationships with internal and external stakeholders in support of the university's goals and values. Stay current with modern case resolution methods and best practices to resolve workplace concerns in a proactive manner. Encourage a workplace culture where all employees are valued, value others and have the opportunity to contribute through their ideas, words and actions, in accordance with the USC Integrity and Accountability Code.Advise leadership on performance management, corrective action, and disciplinary processes with utmost discretion. Provide guidance on rights and responsibilities of management and employee terms and conditions of employment. Interpret policies, employment laws, and labor agreements while guiding consistent and compliant practices that mitigate risk.Consult on, develops and communicates results, corrective actions, and recommendations for appropriate resolutions/resultant actions to an array of complex employee and labor relations issues using a variety of tools (e.g., intake meetings, interviews, facilitated dialogue, shuttle diplomacy, other alternative dispute resolution methods). Draft, implement, and monitor formal and informal resolution plans and. Ensures complete, timely, and accurate documentation in case systems. Maintains knowledge of relationships, labor and employee laws, policies, employment and labor legal trends, and new legislation that could impact the employee/employer relationship.Design and deliver outreach and training to a variety of audiences on matters related to preventing and resolving workplace concerns, managing change, and increasing leader and team effectiveness in alignment with university values policies, procedures. May work in collaboration with other unit members and University Offices to perform projects and conduct background research to assist with cases, training, and development of outreach and other programming materials.Minimum QualificationsThe candidate for the position of Case Resolution Specialist must meet the following qualifications:Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution in a related field including but not limited to: business, psychology, communications, employment law, industrial relations or another related fieldFive years of relevant work experience resolving workplace disputes, engaging in conflict resolution in a large, multi-faceted organization, conducting workplace investigations, and/or any equivalent combination of education and experience. Ability to gather, organize, and synthesize information, conduct analysis, document progress, and make effective recommendations for complex and sensitive issues.Sound judgment, high integrity, and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of current major employment laws and regulations (e.g., ADA, FMLA, NLRA). Experience establishing collaborative initiatives with multiple departments. Strong facilitation skills, with a proven track record of building strong collaborative relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization. Demonstrated ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks and work independently.Ability to gather, organize, and synthesize information, conduct analysis, document progress, and make recommendations for complex and sensitive issues.Ability to adhere and enforce complaint procedures and fundamental components of fair process standards.Knowledge of best practices used to investigate and resolve employee concerns or grievances including best practices as they relate to reducing bias during grievance resolution processes.Proven skill, sensitivity, and experience interacting with a variety of constituents and fostering a culture of belonging and engagement.Demonstrated written and oral communication skills; skill-building rapport in an open, friendly, and accepting way.Ability to present complex issues in a clear, concise, and visually appealing manner.Ability to communicate in writing and verbally for variety of audiences and levels of leadership to inspire further action.Excellent customer service skills.Ability to interpret and apply collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) and labor relations guidance, including NLRB and California PERB requirements.Preferred QualificationsThe ideal candidate for the position of Case Resolution Specialist has the following qualifications:Master’s degree in human resources, psychology, communications, law, industrial relations or another related field, or Juris Doctorate degree.Seven years’ of experience.Experience with iSight, Salesforce, CaseIQ, or other similar case management software or databases.Experience working with a variety of populations in a higher education institutional setting.Experience in, and awareness of, the sensitivity required when interacting with a community on trauma-related topics.Certification and/or experience with complex workplace investigations.Conflict resolution, alternative dispute resolution, or conflict management skills.Strong presentation and facilitation skills with an emphasis on education and training for a variety of constituencies.Demonstrated excellence in writing comprehensive investigative reports.Please submit the following with your application:ResuméCover LetterWriting Sample (will be requested): Candidates selected to move forward in the recruitment process will be required to submit a writing sample. Candidates may provide either a de-identified closure notice from a previous matter or a written response to the provided prompt.The writing sample should be 1–2 pages, no more than 1,200 words, and formatted in 12-point font. Submissions may be redacted or fictionalized as needed to preserve confidentiality.The annual base salary range for this position is $101,000 - $108,000. must ski and load lifts independently. • Experience working or volunteering in service roles or with individuals with disabilities preferred. • One-on-one experience with people with disabilities. • Able to follow directions and work independently.• Valid driver’s license and ability to pass NSCD background check for driving.
